messages:
Devon: noticed a cluster of invoice-preview vs console quota deltas for a handful of Dedicated tenants this morning. preview shows lower tokens billed than Console usage by ~3-7% for some routes.
Maria: thanks for flagging. any common factors (route tags, model alias, region)?
Devon: all on same canary routing policy we rolled last week: per-route sampling + early-kv-cache. same model alias but mixed regions (us-west/us-east). happens around hourly window boundaries.
Alex: could be dedupe window hitting differently between the preview service and final ingester. preview runs on a shadow path that uses batching window 1m, billing-ingest uses 65s dedupe. tiny difference can move an edge token across hour boundary and change aggregation bucket.
Tara: ugh. that 5s mismatch again. did we change any defaults when we added per-route sampling?
Devon: yes, sampler-service defaulted to WINDOW_MS: 60000 but the legacy deduper expects DEDUPE_MS: 65000. config drift after we split services.
Maria: do we have customers seeing actual invoice dollars different or just preview/console mismatch?
Devon: only preview vs console so far. invoices (final) are currently coming from invoice-aggregator which reads post-dedupe counters; seems consistent with billing-ingest. preview pulls from shadow-aggregator which used sampler-service output. So invoices match console, preview is low.
Alex: quick mitigation: update shadow-aggregator to align dedupe window to 65s until we sort out sampler fallback. patch config: ```yaml
sampler_service:
  WINDOW_MS: 65000
```
Tara: Would prefer to make sampler-service accept an env var so rollouts can set it per canary. But urgent fix = align defaults.
Devon: I'm going to patch and roll shadow-aggregator in canary. Can someone update the Console UX to mark invoice-preview as "approximate while sampling canary active"? customers saw differences in preview and opened tickets.
Maria: I'll add a temporary banner and a note on the invoice-preview tooltip. No need to expose internals.
billing-bot: deploy started: shadow-aggregator-canary v2026.03.20-1753 by Devon :rocket:
Devon: rolling now. will monitor telemetry: metering.diff.delta, dedupe.skew, route.sample.rate.
sre-bot: alert muted for metering.diff.delta for the next 30m while canary is applied.
Alex: follow-up: we should add an end-to-end integration test that simulates boundary token timestamps and per-route sampling so this doesn't regress. filing a ticket.
Devon: created ENGPLAT-1437 with repro script and suggested tests. snippet of repro query: ```sql
-- simulate tokens at 59s boundary
insert into tokens (tenant, route, ts, count) values ('t-123','r-a', '2026-03-20T00:00:59Z', 120);
insert into tokens (tenant, route, ts, count) values ('t-123','r-a', '2026-03-20T00:01:00Z', 30);
```
Tara: once patched, schedule a quick backfill-run for affected tenants to be safe?
Maria: let's hold off backfills until we confirm preview-only discrepancy. Backfill costs $$$. we can run a targeted reconciliation for the 7 impacted tenants first.
Devon: agree. patching done on canary. will post results in 10m.
Devon: (10m later) canary looks good, preview delta down to <0.2% for the affected tenants. propagating to prod tomorrow during maintenance window.
Maria: thanks all. add postmortem note about config drift in the rollout checklist.
Devon: adding to rollout UX doc: explicit step to sync dedupe/batching defaults between sampler, shadow-aggregator, and billing-ingest.
Tara: also add a console flag to hide preview until canary is stable. easier than the banner for some enterprise accounts.
Alex: note for the ticket: add automated travis-ci sim for boundary conditions and a rule in k8s config to require DEDUPE_MS alignment when enabling per-route-sampler.
billing-bot: deploy successful: shadow-aggregator-canary v2026.03.20-1753 :white_check_mark:
